value.a: THE FOUR UNKNOWNS OF THE FIRST LIVE PACKET, SETTLED: (1) table grain = per-nexus table, owner 'chart' — the charter's literal words ('its own table'), honored at the tenant grain Law 6 actually gates; (2) resolution floor = the librarian's RESOLUTION_FLOOR imported, n=1 label carried — a per-nexus floor is earned by tuning evidence, not minted at birth; (3) embed cost = one metered+cached embed per /chart crossing plus one per fresh deposit-back, all through inference_domain (yield_report reads it); (4) home-field fencing pre-tenure = three fences: nodes born hypothesis (inherited physics), counsel-not-verdict (the ceiling decides applies), and the dial measuring usage never quality.

THE OWNER PARAMETER IS THE UNIFICATION LANDING, NOT A FORK: trees.py's own docstring filed 'the grant model for other owners' trees' as an edge; the need arrived and resolved simpler than a grant — each owner its own table through the same tools. The librarian's defaults are untouched; its proofs must stay green to prove it.
